scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test tests/unit.test.mjs tests/customer-import.test.mjs
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-camera-portal --only auth,firestore,storage,functions 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration.test.mjs'
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-camera-portal --only auth,firestore,storage,functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only firestore,storage,functions,hosting
